title: Google\Cloud\Recommender\V1\OperationGroup
name: OperationGroup
description: Group of operations that need to be performed atomically.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.operations
params.description: List of operations across one or more resources that belong to this group. Loosely based on RFC6902 and should be performed in the order they appear.

methods.description: List of operations across one or more resources that belong to this group.
